content.short: Mocha reporter logging gas usage for unit tests, method calls, and deployments.
content.description: Ethereum Gas Reporter is a Mocha reporter designed to support smart contract CI/CD by delivering metrics on method calls and deployments, along with the exact gas costs incurred by each unit test. It helps developers monitor gas usage during test runs, enabling comparisons and optimizations of contracts and deployments. The reporter can be used with Truffle and can expose gas-usage visibility in CodeChecks CI/CD pipelines.
